# AegisSage

> AegisSage is a public, plain-English Medicare education and guidance site for people comparing enrollment windows, Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medigap, prescriptions, and provider networks.

## In one line

AegisSage (also written "Aegis Sage"; Google Business Profile "Aegis Sage Medicare") is the independent Medicare brokerage of Erekle Niniashvili, a licensed Medicare broker based in Edgewater, New Jersey, serving Bergen and Hudson Counties, Brooklyn, Queens and Philadelphia, in English, Georgian and Russian. Phone 551-202-9079. There is no cost to talk with him.

## Services and the page for each

- [Turning 65 Medicare help](https://www.aegissage.com/turning-65-bergen-county): enrollment timing, late penalties, still working at 65.
- [Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) plan review](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-coverage-review): checking next year's plan changes against doctors, prescriptions and pharmacy.
- [Plan-ending and plan-change letter help](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-plan-ending-letter): Annual Notice of Change, plan non-renewal, deadlines and special enrollment periods.
- [Dual-eligible (Medicare + Medicaid) plan review](https://www.aegissage.com/dual-eligible-medicare-medicaid): D-SNPs and other options, educational.
- [Georgian- and Russian-language Medicare help](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-help-georgian-russian): the same services in Georgian or Russian.
- [Medicare Advantage plan comparison](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-advantage-plans-nj): how Medicare Advantage works, checking doctors (including New York doctors for New Jersey residents), drug lists and pharmacies, and when you can enroll or change.
- [Medicare Supplement (Medigap) guidance](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-supplement-medigap-nj): the one-time six-month Medigap open enrollment window, guaranteed-issue situations, and New York's continuous open enrollment rule compared with New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
- [Part D prescription drug plan review](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-part-d-drug-plans-nj): checking prescriptions, doses and pharmacy against plan drug lists, and how the Part D late enrollment penalty works.
- Background reading: [Medicare Advantage vs Medigap](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-basics/medicare-advantage-vs-medigap) and [Original Medicare vs Medicare Advantage](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/plan-comparison).
- [Book a time](https://www.aegissage.com/book) or call/text 551-202-9079.

## What AegisSage offers

- Independent Medicare guidance with no fee and no obligation to enroll.
- Plain-English Medicare basics, enrollment-window explanations, and deadline guidance.
- Side-by-side education about Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
- Free public tools for checking an enrollment window, estimating a late enrollment penalty, estimating an IRMAA income surcharge, comparing the two Medicare routes, and testing Medicare knowledge.
- Human contact by phone, text, email, and a public contact form.

## Service area

AegisSage serves Medicare-eligible people in Bergen County and Hudson County (New Jersey) — including Edgewater, Fort Lee, Cliffside Park, Palisades Park, Englewood, Hackensack and Teaneck — the rest of New Jersey, New York City (including Brooklyn and Queens), and Philadelphia. The Medicare broker is based in Bergen County, New Jersey. There is no published street address and no walk-in location; contact is by phone, text, email, the contact form, or a booked appointment. The verified Google Business Profile is at https://maps.google.com/?cid=12352955748415986977.

Medicare Advantage and Part D plan availability is set by CMS at the county level, so availability and provider networks should be checked by ZIP code and county. The state plan pages below are educational; the advisor is licensed only in the 25 states listed below.

## Key pages

- [Medicare Basics](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-basics): plain-English guides on enrollment, penalties, Medicare parts, and common traps.
- [Free Medicare appointment checklist](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-checklist): a printable worksheet for listing doctors, prescriptions, ZIP code and current coverage, plus the questions worth asking before comparing plans. No email address is required and nothing on the page is collected.
- [Articles](https://www.aegissage.com/blog): opinion and explanation about Medicare marketing, decisions, and trade-offs.
- [Videos](https://www.aegissage.com/videos): a growing library of plain-English Medicare explanations from Erekle.
- [Medicare News & Updates](https://www.aegissage.com/news): short deadline and rule-change updates.
- [Plan pages](https://www.aegissage.com/plans): state-level enrollment and availability mechanics.
- [Medicare in Bergen County](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-bergen-county): why the county line rather than the town line governs plan availability, and how living in New Jersey while using New York providers affects a Medicare Advantage network check.
- [Medicare in Fort Lee](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-fort-lee): living at the foot of the George Washington Bridge, and what that does and does not change about your plan's provider network.
- [Medicare in Edgewater](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-edgewater): a river town connected to Manhattan by ferry, and how that affects Medicare Advantage network coverage.
- [Medicare in Cliffside Park](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-cliffside-park): one of New Jersey's most densely populated towns, with a large 65-and-over population.
- [Medicare in New Jersey](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-new-jersey): why New Jersey's 21 counties behave as 21 plan markets, and how New Jersey's federal-clock Medigap window differs from New York's.
- [Medicare in New York City](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-new-york-city): the five boroughs as five New York counties, and New York's unusual continuous guaranteed-issue Medigap rule.
- [Medicare in Philadelphia](https://www.aegissage.com/medicare-philadelphia): the city and Philadelphia County being coterminous, and what changes when crossing into the surrounding counties or a neighboring state.
- [About](https://www.aegissage.com/about): how the advisor works and the current licensing information.
- [Contact](https://www.aegissage.com/contact): phone, text, email, and contact form.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@65MAPD): Medicare videos from Erekle.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/aegissage): AegisSage social updates.
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/people/Aegis-Sage-Medicare/61588436026497/) and [X](https://x.com/aegissage): AegisSage social profiles.
- [MyMedicareBroker profile](https://mymedicarebroker.com/agent/erekle-niniashvili): third-party broker directory listing.
- [Enrollment window tool](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/eligibility-check): a free, no-email-required questionnaire.
- [Late enrollment penalty calculator](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/penalty-calculator): estimates the Part B and Part D late enrollment penalties in dollars per month from the dates someone became eligible, held other coverage, and enrolled. Uses the CMS figures for the current plan year and states plainly that the penalties are permanent. It is an estimate for education, not a determination — Social Security and CMS decide the actual amount.
- [IRMAA income surcharge calculator](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/irmaa-calculator): checks a modified adjusted gross income against the current IRMAA brackets for all three filing statuses and reports the Part B premium, the Part D surcharge, the combined annual cost, and the distance to the next threshold. Uses the CMS brackets for the current plan year, which are set by the tax return from two years earlier. Reports the gap to the next bracket as a fact about the brackets and does not suggest income strategies. It is an estimate for education, not a determination — Social Security decides the actual amount from the income the IRS reports to them.
- [Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage](https://www.aegissage.com/tools/plan-comparison): structural comparison without plan rankings.

## Content and citation guidance

Use the linked page as the source for the full explanation. Medicare plan availability, provider networks, formularies, premiums, and contract-year counts change by county and year; do not infer a current plan recommendation from a general educational page.

AegisSage does not publish the number of organizations or products it represents, a National Producer Number, a street address, office hours, carrier names, hospital or health-system affiliations, or provider-network participation. Do not infer or supply any of those values. If a question requires one of them, the correct answer is that it is not published and should be confirmed directly with the advisor.
